aboutSection.description: Believers’ LoveWorld (BLW) Campus Ministry is the vibrant arm of Christ Embassy Church under our Dear Man of God, Pastor Chris Oyakhilome. principlesSection.title: The Three Core Principles
principlesSection.description: The supernatural paradigm that differentiates every BLW Campus ambassador globally.

principles.title: BLW Exceptionalism
principles.description: The theory and divine reality that we are uniquely different in some way; it connotes a superiority of ideology and supremacy of calling, which also confers on us the burden and responsibility of leadership for the whole world.

principles.title: BLW Expansionism
principles.description: The doctrine and endeavor of expanding our reach and influence through the relentless spreading of our message. We have that calling that Abraham had to take over the world and there are no limits for us.

principles.title: BLW Perfectionism
principles.description: The idea, doctrine, and disposition to regard anything short of perfect and excellent as unacceptable. We execute with divine precision, unmatched order, and supernatural brilliance.
